description: On the red bedspread in front of you are two small white drawer pieces: a taller cabinet base with a lower knob, and a separate shallow drawer with its own knob. The left hand holds the taller cabinet steady while the right hand grips the smaller drawer by its knob, lifts it up and left, aligns it with the cabinet opening, then slides it inward until it seats, with both hands briefly touching the assembled box before the right hand releases.
